name: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate dependent Rac exchange factor 2
pathways: regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction

function.text: PREX2 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate-dependent Rac exchanger 2 protein (PtdIns(3,4,5)-dependent Rac exchanger 2). Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma; Colon Adenocarcinoma; Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
